heading: 101.01 - Designation—How cited.
text:
As set forth in the Adopting Ordinance, the provisions contained in this and the following
chapters shall constitute the Columbus City Codes, 1959.

The Columbus City Codes, 1959, may be referred to as the "city codes"; any component
code of the city codes may be referred to by its name, such as the "Traffic Code";
and sections of the city codes may be cited by the designation "C.C." followed by
the number, such as "C.C. 101.01." Title, article, chapter, and section headings do
not constitute any part of the law as contained in the Columbus City Codes.

(Ord. 877-72.)

heading: 101.02 - Amendments and supplements.
text:
The Columbus City Codes, 1959, may be amended or supplemented at any time and, when
any amendment or supplement is adopted in such form as to indicate the intention of
council to make the same a part thereof, such amendment or supplement shall be incorporated
in, and deemed a part of, the city codes, so that a reference to the city codes shall
be understood and construed as including the Columbus City Codes, 1959, and any and
all such amendments and supplements.

heading: 101.03 - Interpretation.
text:
In the construction of the city codes, the following rules shall control, excepting
those inconsistent with the manifest intent of council as disclosed in a particular
provision, section or chapter:

(a)

Authority. Whenever in the city codes authority is given to an officer or an act is
required to be performed, such authority may be exercised and such act may be performed,
at the instance of such officer, by a deputy or subordinate unless contrary to law
or to the clear intent of any such particular provision.

(b)

Bound. The terms "bound" or "binding" shall mean to enclose in a binding or cover
or to store by means of electronic cataloging and/or indexing.

(c)

Calendar—Computation of Time. The terms "month" and "year" shall mean the calendar
month or year. The time expressed in days within which an act is to be done or a period
is to expire shall be computed by excluding the first and including the last day except
if the last be Sunday it shall be excluded. If time is expressed in hours the whole
of Sunday shall be excluded.

(d)

City and Municipality. The words "city" and "municipality" shall mean the city of
Columbus, Ohio.

(e)

Conjunctions. "And" shall include "or" and "or" shall include "and" if the sense so
requires.

(f)

Council. The word "council" means the council of the city of Columbus, Ohio.

(g)

County. The word "county" means the county of Franklin, Ohio.

(h)

Distribution. The terms "distribution" or "distributing" shall mean the act of making
information available either by traditional or electronic mail or by other traditional
or electronic means.

(i)

Fire Department. The terms "fire department" or "fire division" shall mean the division
of fire of the department of public safety of the city of Columbus, Ohio.

(j)

Gender. Words importing the masculine shall extend and be applied to the feminine
and neuter genders.

(k)

General Rule. Excepting as otherwise provided in this section, words and phrases shall
be construed according to the common usage of language; provided, however, that technical
words and phrases and such others as may have acquired a special meaning in the law,
shall be construed according to such technical or special meaning.

(l)

Jobs Development. The term "jobs development department" or "department of jobs development"
means the department of development

(m)

Joint Authority. Words giving authority to a board, commission or to three (3) or
more officers or employees or other persons shall be construed as giving authority
to a majority thereof unless otherwise specifically provided.

(n)

Keeper or Proprietor. The words "keeper" or "proprietor" shall mean and include persons,
firms, associations, corporations, clubs and copartnerships, whether acting by themselves
or as a servant, agent or employee.

(o)

Land or Real Estate. The terms "land" or "real estate" include rights and easements
of incorporeal nature.

(p)

Number. Words in the plural include the singular and in the singular shall include
the plural number.

(q)

Oath. The word "oath" includes affirmation. When an oath is required or authorized
by law, an affirmation in lieu thereof may be taken by a person having conscientious
scruples to taking an oath. An affirmation shall have the same force and effect as
an oath.

(r)

Owner. The word "owner" when applied to property shall include any part-owner, joint
owner or tenant in common, of the whole or any part of such property.

(s)

Person. The word "person" shall extend to and be applied to associations, clubs, corporations,
firms, partnerships, and bodies politic, as well as to individuals.

(t)

Police Department. The terms "police department" or "police division" shall mean the
division of police of the department of public safety of the city of Columbus, Ohio.

(u)

Premises. The word "premises" when used as applicable to property shall extend to
and include land and buildings.

(v)

Printed. The word "printed," or the process of "printing" shall mean the production
of information or data by traditional or electronic means.

(w)

Public Authority. The term "public authority" shall extend to and include boards of
education, county, state and federal officers and any duly authorized public official.

(x)

Publish (or published). The word "publish" shall be deemed to make available, as a
book, electronic document, or other printed work, either for sale or for general distribution.

(y)

Property. The word "property" shall include real and personal, and any mixed and lesser
estates or interests therein; the words "personal property" shall include every kind
of property except real property; and the words "real property" shall include lands,
tenements and hereditaments.

(z)

Reasonable Time. In all cases where provision is made for an act to be done or notice
to be given within a reasonable time, it shall be deemed to mean such time only as
may be necessary for the prompt performance of such act or giving of such notice.

(aa)

Regulations. The term "regulations" when referring to the name of a division of the
city administration means the building services division of the department of development.

(bb)

Sidewalk. The word "sidewalk" shall mean any portion of a street between the curb
line and the adjacent property line, intended for the use of pedestrians, excluding
parkways.

(cc)

State. The word "state" shall mean the state of Ohio.

(dd)

Street. The word "street" shall be construed to include alleys, avenues, boulevards,
lanes, roads, streets and other public ways in the city unless the width of the right-of-way
is a critical consideration.

(ee)

Tenant or Occupant. The words "tenant" or "occupant" as applied to building or land
shall extend and be applied to any person holding a written or oral lease of or who
occupies the whole or any part of a building or land, alone or with others.

(ff)

Tenses. The use of any verb in the present tense shall include the future.

(gg)

Written. The terms "written" or "in writing" shall be construed to include any representation
of words, letters or figures, whether by printing or otherwise.

(Ord. 2923-86; Ord. 1272-01 § 1 (part); Ord. 1669-01 § 1; Ord. 2044-01 § 1.)
